items.html: And behold, when the two of them were one Partzuf, and she gave birth to these Mochin of ZA, and they then come out from the Yesod of the totality of the two Partzufim together, the Tzelem of the Mochin is found standing suspended in the air, outside the Yesod, between the two first joints of the NH of the totality, which is now the GAR of this Tevuna, as above; and this phase is the Mem of the Tzelem, since the Mochin have not yet clothed within the Tevuna. And since they are without clothing, it is recognizable that they are literally four Mochin, which are HB, HG, each one included of ten, totaling the Mem of the Tzelem.
